steps.content: The show has started. The dressing room is deserted, its lights off. The door creaks open, and a figure peeks inside cautiously before tiptoeing in.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I was only gone for three days... and they already packed all my stuff away.

She walks to her vanity, where only a few basic makeup tools remain. Her fingertip glides across the surface, tracing a line through a thin layer of dust. Crouching down, she rummages through the drawers until, at the very back, she finds the familiar doll in the gray trench coat, and a few letters she'd written.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Thank goodness you're still here... Otherwise I'd really have to give Mr. E a piece of my mind.

She sits the doll in a corner of the vanity, then sets down the letters on the tabletop, next to the photograph she always carries with her. She doesn't turn on the lights; leaning against the table, she lights a small candle. Its fragile flame casts a gentle glow on this fleeting moment of peace.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: This place hardly ever gives us time to rest... No dancing, no guests to entertain. It's nice.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Remember when I told you I was going to help Sallie elope? I meant it. It wasn't just some crazy idea! I even took out the creep who was hurting her. Got a few cuts myself.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: But it's okay! It doesn't hurt anymore. Mr. E had me patched up. After all, there's a long line of guests waiting to chat with me. Hehe, it's almost embarrassing to say it out loud.
She gently traces the outline of the person in the photo, leaning close as if worried they might not hear.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I know Mr. E keeps us locked up here because he's afraid of us. His eyes are everywhere...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: But even the most airtight cage has cracks, right?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Once I know the name of Sallie's sweetheart, I can find a way to get word out. The guests, Cassian, the staff who love to gossip... they could all be our chance.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Speaking of Cassian... that guy seems easygoing, but he's got his guard up. Still, I know he's waiting for his chance. As long as we want the same thing... he'll help me. I'm sure of it.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: What do you think, darling? It's a pretty solid plan, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: It feels... incredible. I'm actually helping someone. I can protect someone! It makes me so happy.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: When we see each other... will you be proud of me?
Outside, the festive music is winding down. Milly knows her rare moment of peace is over. As footsteps approach, she reluctantly stows the photo and letters and closes the drawer.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Oops, someone's coming... I'll talk to you later. Maybe the next time we talk, I'll have good news. Wait for me, okay?
